Known dataset traps and how they are treated
Handled LIM_FX_FFILL
USD/CAD uses the Bank of Canada daily rate; on days without a published rate the previous rate is carried forward.
Treatment: CAD/USD mismatch and FX holiday gaps: the datastore returns only the last rate published on or before a day, never a later one (datastore tests: days without a same-day rate, no prior rate); every USD figure is converted by quant M_FX_BOC_FFILL (T05), checked against the CAD control values (QNT-02) and the no-prior-rate case (QNT-06).
Handled LIM_CALENDAR_INTERSECTION
Only days when both the Canadian and US markets were open are used; crypto weekend moves appear on the next trading day.
Treatment: Master calendar XIU.TO ∩ SPY with crypto sampled on those days and no price fill (datastore DS-02, DS-07).
Disclosed LIM_YAHOO_NOT_CERTIFIED
Prices come from Yahoo Finance and are not exchange-certified. Adjusted closes change when data is re-downloaded.
Treatment: adj_close used as published; splits and dividends are annotations and never re-applied; checksums pin the snapshot. Original price vintages are not available.
Disclosed LIM_CNQ_FACTOR
Yahoo reports a 1.021 "split" for CNQ.TO on 2022-08-22, the day of a 0.75 CAD dividend. It likely reflects a special distribution; not confirmed with the company.
Treatment: Split anomaly flagged at ingestion; limitation attached to CNQ.TO reads spanning 2022-08-22; not applied twice.
Open LIM_MACRO_LAG_ASSUMED
Publication dates of monthly macro data are approximated with a fixed lag.
Treatment: Monthly values use real release dates when macro_release_dates covers them (Canada CPI from Statistics Canada in snap-20261114-sourced); otherwise current runs use the A-22 lag and historical runs withhold them. US monthly FRED series have no release/vintage data loaded.
Disclosed LIM_MACRO_REVISED
US macro values are the latest revised figures, not as first published.
Treatment: FRED values are latest vintages; withheld from historical runs unless vintage dates are supplied.
Disclosed LIM_SURVIVORSHIP
The asset universe was chosen in 2026 among names that are large today, which flatters historical results.
Treatment: Universe selected in 2026; disclosed on every universe and price passport.
Disclosed LIM_NO_CONTROVERSY_DATA
No controversy or ESG rating dataset is loaded. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
Treatment: No ESG, news or fundamentals dataset loaded; evidence rules stay 'insufficient data'.
Disclosed LIM_ETF_NO_LOOKTHROUGH
Funds are treated as single diversified positions; their underlying holdings are not counted in sector or single-name limits.
Treatment: Funds are single diversified positions; sector and single-name caps use direct equities only.

“Handled” is the API’s claim of an implemented, tested treatment; “disclosed” means the limitation is shown but not corrected.
